name: rounding_mode
prompt: fix round_half_up in mod.py: values ending exactly in .5 must round away from zero, not to even

files.mod.py:
def round_half_up(x):
    return round(x)  # BUG: Python rounds to even

tests.test_mod.py:
from mod import round_half_up

def test_rounding():
    assert round_half_up(2.5) == 3
    assert round_half_up(3.5) == 4
    assert round_half_up(2.4) == 2
    assert round_half_up(-2.5) == -3
